scope: Split the Round16 pp_pre->pack_mid normalization/leading-bit/GRS cone with one additional real register boundary for ordinary FP producers while preserving iterative DIV/SQRT, special-value priority, packed-half lanes, response hold, kill/reset and architectural commit timing.

implementation.summary: Added fp_round_pre_t pack_pre* and IT_PACK_PRE. Ordinary pp_pre producers now execute registered leading-one/exponent classification, registered normalization/GRS construction, then existing p2 final pack. Iterative DIV/SQRT uses round_pack_iter_p1 and retains IT_FIN->IT_PACK. A follow-up fix restores round_pack_h's local integer emax declaration.

state_boundary.IT_PREP: For uses_round_pack_pre, round_pack_pre captures special metadata, leading-one index, exponent classification and tiny/zero status into pack_pre*; no result or iter_done.
state_boundary.IT_PACK_PRE: round_pack_p1 consumes registered pack_pre* and constructs mantissa/guard/sticky/discarded into pack_mid*; no result or iter_done.
state_boundary.IT_PACK: round_pack_p2 consumes registered pack_mid*, performs increment/overflow/subnormal/FZ/AHP/final pack and presents one iter_done/result pulse.
state_boundary.iterative_div_sqrt: IT_FIN calls round_pack_iter_p1 directly from div_pre/sqrt_pre and enters the unchanged IT_PACK path; no added iterative stage.
state_boundary.reset_kill: Reset or iter_kill sets it_state_r=IT_IDLE and clears pack_pre*, pack_mid*, it_fin_valid_r and all prior non-architectural payloads.
state_boundary.valid_drop: IT_PREP, IT_PACK_PRE and IT_PACK return to IT_IDLE and clear the new/related payload without iter_done; earlier states cannot expose a new payload.
state_boundary.iter_pause: The existing !iter_pause state-machine gate holds IT_PACK_PRE and payload; final IT_PACK suppresses p2/iter_done while paused and resumes from the registered payload.
state_boundary.architectural_commit: No architectural state or commit interface changed; V/GPR/NZCV/FPSR effects remain in the existing slot/response/commit path.

latency.other_pp_other_ops: CMP, FMIN/FMAX, FRINT and FCVTZS/FCVTZU unchanged
latency.pause: paused cycles are additive and excluded from nominal latency

semantics.special_priority: Special/NaN/zero/Inf paths carry the existing fp_pre special payload through both new registers; no new classification priority was introduced.
semantics.rounding: Normal and tiny paths preserve the original leading-one, exponent, mantissa, guard, sticky and discarded calculations before unchanged round_pack_p2.
semantics.fpcr_fpsr: DN/FZ/FZ16/AHP/RMode and input FPSR flags are copied into the new payload; p2 flag OR and output behavior are unchanged.
semantics.packed_half: Both H lanes use pack_pre_lo/hi and pack_mid_lo/hi; FCVT remains a single-lane path.

known_limits: T-009 is still the active broad-validation dependency; this speculative lane cannot be integrated or called functionally green until the dependency and joint candidate tests pass.
No Verilator/Cocotb/QEMU result is claimed from the Icarus static compile; the reported exit code only checks parser acceptance.
Physical timing improvement, resource cost and actual post-fit logic depth require a fresh full-FP rerun on the merged candidate SHA.
The added boundary increases ordinary pp_pre latency by one cycle per scalar slot and does not change iterative DIV/SQRT nominal latency.
The new packed metadata includes integer exponent fields; joint simulator and synthesis checks must confirm tool handling and bit-exact behavior for tiny/carry cases.
